sentences.text: Shayara Bano vs State Of U.P. And Another on 21 July, 2023

Author: Krishan Pahal
Bench: Krishan Pahal
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:145446
Court No. - 72
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 7701 of 2023
Applicant :- Shayara Bano

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another

Counsel for Applicant :- Firdos Ahmad,Atul Kumar Yadav Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
1. List has been revised.

2. Heard Sri Firdos Ahmad, learned counsel for applicant as well as Sri V.K.S. Parmar, learned Additional Government Advocate for State.
3.
The present application for anticipatory bail has been filed for protection in regard to Case Crime No.0133 of 2021, under Sections 420, 467, 468 I.P.C., P.S. Kandharapur, District Azamgarh.

4. After arguing for some time, applicant's counsel submits that the present application for anticipatory bail may be disposed of with a direction to file a regular bail application which may be decided keeping in view the guidelines as laid down by the Apex Court in the case of Satender Shayara Bano vs State Of U.P. And Another on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/196555330/
1

entities.text: Satender Shayara Bano vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in 2022 SCC OnLine SC 825.

entities.text: Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in 2022 SCC OnLine SC 825
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. Learned A.G.A. has no objection to the prayer of learned counsel for the applicant.

6. After hearing learned counsel for the parties, no case is made out for interference U/s 438 Cr.P.C.
The present anticipatory bail application is disposed of with a direction that the applicant shall surrender before the concerned court within one month from today and in case a regular bail application is filed, the same be decided in view of the law laid down by the Supreme Court in case of Satender Kumar Antil (supra).
7.

For the period of one month from today or till the time of surrender of the applicant before the concerned court, whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant, in the above case.

(Krishan Pahal, J.) Order Date :- 21.7.2023 Ravi Kant  Shayara Bano vs State Of U.P. And Another on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/196555330/
2
